title: Meet Lyria 3.5, Google's new music generation AI
title_candidates: How Google's AI turns words into a full song with real vocals
The AI inside Google's app that composes full songs from a single sentence
Google built an AI that writes, sings, and produces music for you
What happens when you describe a song to Google's AI and it actually makes it
This is what Google's AI music sounds like when you give it a simple idea
caption:
Google's AI can turn a short text description into a full song with real vocals, inside the Gemini app.

Lyria 3.5 is their best music model yet. You type what you want: a style, a mood, a feeling. It writes and produces the whole track from scratch. The vocal quality is a clear step up from anything Google has released before, and new creative controls let you shape how experimental the output gets.
